name: Thunderbolt
author: unleashed-nick
description: Approve and manage Thunderbolt devices through bolt, with a bar widget and connect prompt.

barWidget.description: Approve new Thunderbolt devices and manage bolt enrollments.

schema.label: Prompt on connect
schema.description: When a new Thunderbolt device needs approval, send a notification and open this panel.

schema.label: Always show in bar
schema.description: Keep the Thunderbolt icon visible even on machines with no controller and no remembered devices.

schema.label: Trust policy
schema.description: Policy used when you tap Trust. Auto authorizes the device the next time it is plugged in.

schema.label: Automatically trust new devices
schema.description: Enroll new devices as soon as they appear, like GNOME Shell. Leave off unless you accept the DMA risk; this machine has no IOMMU.
